burnPanel.hintZip:
All three options use the same images from the PACS; only how folders are arranged in the file or on disc changes.

• STUDY (ZIP): One .zip download. Inside it, paths begin with uppercase STUDY/<study-uid>/…

• OHIF ISO: A disc image to burn. Files go under lowercase study/<study-uid>/… for the on-disc OHIF viewer. There is no uppercase STUDY/ root like in the ZIP.

• K-PACS ISO: A separate disc layout for K-PACS on Windows. It uses a DICOM/ tree and a DICOMDIR file.
